name: forward to side to rear lunge
description: A lunge sequence that steps forward, to the side and then back with the same leg. It trains the legs and hips from three directions and challenges your balance.
instructions: Stand tall with your feet together and hands on your hips.
Step one foot forward into a lunge, then push back to standing.
Step the same foot out to the side, sit back into the hip, then return to center.
Step the same foot backward into a lunge and push back to standing.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking over your toes, then switch legs after your set.
